description: Staleness and eligibility per tier and workflow, read by pump/due.mjs. mode: always = due when there is no result for the current run_key (first sight, new SHA or digest, new tool, oracle or probe version), on a change event, or when the last result is older than max_age_days (null = no age limit); sample = due only when a sampling hook picks it; never = not run for this tier. capture_range_max_age_days is passed through to live-probe and is not used by the due list yet. A run_key sent back as retry_later (every skip retryable) is not due again until retry_backoff_minutes x 2^(n-1) after its n-th retry. unversioned_max_age_days: for a subject with no sha and no artifact digest (its run_key cannot move with new versions), the max age used where a cell's max_age_days is null. A run_key sent back as retry_throttled (every skip a retryable rate limit or upstream outage) waits the same backoff, never more than retry_backoff_max_minutes. skips_only_max_age_days: an accepted result that held no records and only retryable skips whose retries ran out is due again after this many days (reason skips_only), doubling for each such result in a row, never later than the tier's max age. priority.coverage_gap_share: a due pair that has no result yet, whose last result is unassessed by our own limit (a tool or unknown fault), or that was never assessed and last hit a passing condition gets this share of its tier weight added to its priority (R-COV-03); it orders due pairs and never makes a pair due.
